digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler — inbound link removal applier
propositions: A removal record for a managed link without peer confirmation should be declined — no UNLINK event written, link remains net-active locally, and WARNING logged
The confirmation check must consult the peer_confirmations store before removing, returning False if unconfirmed to keep the silent-no-op canary truthful
A removal record for a link WITH peer confirmation still converges normally — relation-scoped UNLINK via rebar.unlink
A local link whose outbound ADD is deduped by same-vendor-type remote link in opposite direction is protected from removal by unconfirmed records
The fail-open contract: unopenable confirmation store (None) disables the check and restores pre-story behavior exactly
Per-pass INFO summary must report the count of declined removal records alongside impossible-link skips for operator visibility
